# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable retry policy.

## Retry policy

Configure the runner with `RetryConfig::new(max_attempts, base_delay_ms,
max_delay_ms)`. `max_attempts` includes the initial call. Only
`RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; permanent failures are returned
immediately. Before each retry, the runner sleeps for an exponentially growing
delay (base, 2x base, and so on), capped at `max_delay_ms`.

`run_job` accepts an injected `Sleeper`, so applications can provide a real
clock-backed sleeper and tests can use `FakeSleeper` without waiting.
